product.title: New York City Private Walking Tour with a Local
product.description: You could explore Manhattan on your own—but a guided walking tour makes finding (and learning about) the sights so much easier. On this flexible tour, choose a duration and itinerary that work best for your schedule, and explore with just your private guide for company. Look forward to experiencing the energy of Times Square, relaxing in Bryant Park, exploring media history at Rockefeller Center, and much more.
highlights: Exploring on foot makes it easy to soak up the city’s lively atmosphere
Discover many of Manhattan’s best-known sights, all in a single trip
This private tour offers a more personalized sightseeing experience
Your guide reveals insider New York City sights and stories along the way
exclusions: Tickets to out of plan attractions
